assets.name: 星星短发
assets.prompt: Redesign the character in reference image 1 into a MUCH CUTER, youthful, flat 2D chibi stationery-game avatar. Reference 1 is the character/color identity ONLY; DO NOT keep its mature face, makeup, rendering or anatomy. Reference 2 is the correct game art direction: simple bold grape-purple outlines, rounded colorful shapes, flat-to-two-tone fills, white die-cut sticker edge and small lavender drop shadow. Keep the coral pink bob, mint star hairclip and lemon sweater, but radically simplify. The head should be a very round mochi-like shape, huge relative to tiny rounded shoulders, almost no visible neck. Face: two small simple dark-purple oval eyes with just a tiny white dot, small curved brows, little blush dots, tiny curved smiling mouth; OMIT realistic lips, lipstick, eyelashes, eyeliner, realistic nose, cheekbone shading, and detailed iris rendering. Cute playful youthful mascot proportions, cozy and approachable, like a compact kawaii journal character sticker. No pin-up glamour, no adult fashion illustration, no 3D rendering. Hair: simple rounded bob silhouette with only 4–6 large locks and ONE broad pastel highlight, not many individual strands. Clothes: only the sweater collar and small shoulders, no detailed folds. Strong large silhouette and minimal details must read at 40px. One centered head-and-shoulders avatar, square transparent PNG, entire white sticker edge contained with at least 8 percent padding on every side. Keep palette coral #FF638B, grape #6645AA, lemon #FFE36B, mint #69D8B1, cream #FFF9EE. No text, no logos, no extra characters, no surrounding decorative objects or frame. True transparency outside sticker. This is a replacement visual direction sample, not an adult portrait.
